description: Foundation: the pure, I/O-free shared denylist predicate module plus the shared schema and defaults in packages/types. No runtime behavior changes yet — this is the single source of truth consumed by FEAT-002 (runtime enforcement) and FEAT-003 (persisted setting). Independent of FEAT-002/003 in isolation but MUST land first because both depend on these exports.
steps: Create src/services/glob/readDenylist.ts exporting: (a) interface ReadDenylistConfig { vendoredDirs: readonly string[]; rootDirs: readonly string[]; files: readonly string[]; globs: readonly string[] }; (b) the pure isDeniedRead(relPath: string, config: ReadDenylistConfig, opts?: { knownTarget?: boolean }): { denied: boolean; category?: string } implementing the five-step match semantics from design §B — (1) normalize relPath to forward-slash workspace-relative and split segments, return {denied:false} immediately if opts.knownTarget, (2) deny if any segment equals a vendoredDirs entry, (3) deny if the FIRST segment equals a rootDirs entry or matches an `out-*`-style prefix (entries ending in `*` are prefix-matched), (4) deny if the basename is in files, (5) deny if any globs entry matches via the already-present `ignore` library against the full relPath; category = matched `field:entry`; a malformed relPath fails open to {denied:false}.

In the same module export extractKnownTargetPaths(message: string): Set<string> implementing the design §B path-literal grammar: a token that contains at least one `/`, ends in an extension `.[A-Za-z0-9]+` (support compound `.d.ts`), is bare whitespace/paren/comma/semicolon-delimited OR backtick/single/double-quoted; strip a trailing `:line` or `:line:col` suffix before storing; reject any token containing a `..` segment (no traversal). Return normalized workspace-relative paths.

In the same module export mergeReadDenylist(stored: Partial<ReadDenylistConfig> | undefined, defaults: ReadDenylistConfig): ReadDenylistConfig with per-field replace-over-default semantics (design §F NIT 6): for each of vendoredDirs/rootDirs/files/globs, if the stored config OMITS the key inherit the default array unchanged; if it PROVIDES the key (including an explicit empty array []) that array REPLACES the default for that field (so [] clears a category). This is NOT the numeric key-merge of mergeRouteCapacityMap.

In packages/types/src/global-settings.ts add: the DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST constant with exactly the design §B values — vendoredDirs: node_modules, vendor, Pods, .pnpm-store, .stryker-tmp, __pycache__; rootDirs: dist, out, out-*, build, coverage; files: package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock; globs: **/node_modules/@types/**, **/typescript/lib/*.d.ts, **/*.min.js, **/*.min.css, **/*.js.map, **/*.css.map, target/dependency/**, build/dependencies/** . Add DEFAULT_WORKER_READ_INPUT_BUDGET_BYTES = 600_000 and BUDGET_TIGHTENED_LINE_LIMIT = 500 as shared constants. Add parallelReadDenylistSchema (a zod object of four optional string-array fields, following the parallelCapacityMapSchema precedent at ~:216) and add `parallelReadDenylist: parallelReadDenylistSchema.optional()` to globalSettingsSchema. Do NOT hand-edit GLOBAL_SETTINGS_KEYS — it is derived via globalSettingsSchema.keyof().options.
In packages/types/src/vscode-extension-host.ts add "parallelReadDenylist" to the ExtensionState key union next to "parallelCapacityMap" (~:341).

Add unit tests. src/services/glob/__tests__/readDenylist.spec.ts: the full isDeniedRead truth table from design Testability — DENIED rows node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts, typescript/lib/lib.dom.d.ts, package-lock.json, app.min.js, root dist/bundle.js, root out/x.js, target/dependency/foo.jar; ALLOWED rows src/core/task/Task.ts, src/types/global.d.ts, docs/x.md, packages/pkg/index.ts, src/features/build/pipeline.ts, services/deps/client.ts, fixtures/sample.map, nested webview-ui/out/README.md; plus a Known_Target override row and a cleared-category (merged config with globs:[] via mergeReadDenylist) override row; extractKnownTargetPaths rows: bare .d.ts, backtick-quoted path, path:line stripped, ..-traversal rejected. packages/types/src/__tests__/parallelReadDenylist.spec.ts: schema set/empty/unset round-trip and per-field replace-merge (omit=inherit default; []=clear).

Run `pnpm --dir src exec eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 services/glob/readDenylist.ts services/glob/__tests__/readDenylist.spec.ts` and the analogous `--dir packages/types` check on the two edited/added types files; confirm no suppression-count increase. No `as any`, no floating promises.
acceptance_criteria: isDeniedRead denies every DENIED truth-table path and allows every ALLOWED path, with knownTarget short-circuit and cleared-category override working (design AC-1..AC-8).
extractKnownTargetPaths extracts bare/quoted/path:line forms and rejects .. traversal.
mergeReadDenylist: unset config == byte-for-byte default (AC-6); an explicit [] on a field clears that category.
parallelReadDenylist is accepted by globalSettingsSchema and round-trips through parallelReadDenylistSchema (set/empty/unset).
verification: pnpm --dir packages/types exec eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 src/global-settings.ts src/vscode-extension-host.ts src/__tests__/parallelReadDenylist.spec.ts
findings:
Exported API surface for FEAT-002/003 to import.

== src/services/glob/readDenylist.ts (new) ==
- interface ReadDenylistConfig { vendoredDirs: readonly string[]; rootDirs: readonly string[]; files: readonly string[]; globs: readonly string[] }
- isDeniedRead(relPath: string, config: ReadDenylistConfig, opts?: { knownTarget?: boolean }): { denied: boolean; category?: string }
    * Pure, no I/O. Five-step match: (1) knownTarget short-circuit -> {denied:false}; (2) any segment == vendoredDirs entry; (3) FIRST segment == rootDirs entry, with `*`-suffix entries prefix-matched (e.g. 'out-*'); (4) basename in files; (5) any globs entry matches via the `ignore` lib against the full normalized relPath. category = matched 'field:entry' (e.g. 'vendoredDirs:node_modules', 'rootDirs:dist', 'files:package-lock.json', 'globs:**/*.min.js'). Malformed/absolute/`..`-traversal relPath fails open to {denied:false}.
- extractKnownTargetPaths(message: string): Set<string>
    * Returns normalized workspace-relative paths from spec.message prose. Token must contain '/', end in .[A-Za-z0-9]+ (compound .d.ts ok), bare or backtick/single/double-quoted; trailing ':line' or ':line:col' stripped; '..'-traversal tokens rejected. FEAT-002 (Task.ts) seeds Task.knownTargetPaths SOLELY from extractKnownTargetPaths(spec.message); Task.isKnownTargetPath(relPath) does normalized membership; ReadFileTool passes opts.knownTarget = task.isKnownTargetPath(relPath).
- mergeReadDenylist(stored: Partial<ReadDenylistConfig> | undefined, defaults: ReadDenylistConfig): ReadDenylistConfig
    * Per-field REPLACE-over-default (NOT numeric key-merge). Omitted field inherits default array; provided field (incl. explicit []) replaces it, so [] clears a category. undefined stored => byte-for-byte default. FEAT-003 ClineProvider.getEffectiveReadDenylist() should call mergeReadDenylist(providerState.parallelReadDenylist, DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST).

== packages/types/src/global-settings.ts (exported, import from '@roo-code/types') ==
- DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST (as-const object): vendoredDirs=[node_modules,vendor,Pods,.pnpm-store,.stryker-tmp,__pycache__]; rootDirs=[dist,out,out-*,build,coverage]; files=[package-lock.json,pnpm-lock.yaml,yarn.lock]; globs=[**/node_modules/@types/**,**/typescript/lib/*.d.ts,**/*.min.js,**/*.min.css,**/*.js.map,**/*.css.map,target/dependency/**,build/dependencies/**]. Structurally assignable to ReadDenylistConfig.
- DEFAULT_WORKER_READ_INPUT_BUDGET_BYTES = 600_000 (number) — Lever 2 default byte budget for FEAT-002 ReadFileTool byte accounting.
- BUDGET_TIGHTENED_LINE_LIMIT = 500 (number) — monotonic min() clamp for budget-crossed default-limit reads (FEAT-002 batched/slice/indentation paths).
- parallelReadDenylistSchema = z.object({ vendoredDirs, rootDirs, files, globs } each z.array(z.string()).optional()).
- globalSettingsSchema now has `parallelReadDenylist: parallelReadDenylistSchema.optional()`; GLOBAL_SETTINGS_KEYS auto-includes 'parallelReadDenylist' (derived, not hand-edited).

== packages/types/src/vscode-extension-host.ts ==
- 'parallelReadDenylist' added to the ExtensionState key union next to 'parallelCapacityMap'.

Notes for FEAT-002/003: no runtime wiring was added (ReadFileTool, ParallelTaskReader, Task.ts, ClineProvider, webviewMessageHandler, SettingsView all untouched). The `ignore` library is imported as `import ignore from 'ignore'` and matched via ignore().add(pattern).ignores(relPath). ReadFileTool reads provider state via task.providerRef.deref()?.getState(); FEAT-003 must add parallelReadDenylist to getState() default (merge over DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST) and to getStateToPostToWebview() destructure+return. DEFAULT_READ_DENYLIST lives in packages/types (per FEAT-001 step 4), NOT in readDenylist.ts.
